title: Write about travel plans
description: Short writing tasks about journeys and station situations.

items.prompt: Write 2–3 sentences about a trip you are going to take.
items.promptIt: Scrivi 2–3 frasi su un viaggio che stai per fare.
hints: I am going to take the train...

items.prompt: Write one question you can ask at the station.
items.promptIt: Scrivi una domanda che puoi fare in stazione.
hints: What time does the train depart?
